itemArchitectureDecisions.uniqueItemIdentity: Each existing item gets a stable unique ID when dungeon data loads; moving does not change ID
itemArchitectureDecisions.currentPrototypeIdentity: 0:3:14:EAST:Weapon:2 is a temporary location-derived torch identifier; not yet linked to full registry
itemArchitectureDecisions.state: Each item retains individual properties (charges, burning stage, flags); no duplication across cursor, holder, floor, inventory
itemArchitectureDecisions.idReuse: Do not recycle consumed-item IDs; allocate new IDs
itemArchitectureDecisions.locations: Mouse hand, wall fixture, floor tile/corner, champion inventory, container; one location per item
itemArchitectureDecisions.stacking: Support multiple independent records at one floor corner without small fixed limits
itemArchitectureDecisions.currentLimitations: No inventory placement, return-to-holder gameplay, floor dropping, throwing, or save/load integration yet; burning/charges not integrated with pickup
itemArchitectureDecisions.universalThrowingRule: Every item the player can pick up can be thrown. Implement throwing as a generic item interaction, never as a torch-only special case.
itemArchitectureDecisions.throwIdentityRule: Throwing, landing, and subsequent pickup transfer the same item instance and ID, preserving item properties; never duplicate or re-create items.
itemArchitectureDecisions.throwRenderingRule: Ground rendering for thrown items requires the appropriate explicit item asset at supported depths; missing assets produce errors rather than fallbacks.
